purpose: Define a bounded, auditable search for lawful datasets containing observed investment-related text after DFPI, UBCKNN and FCA were confirmed to be evidence-only channels.

target_roles.required_content: observed investment-related post, message or website copy
target_roles.required_evidence: independent official or primary evidence distinct from the text artifact

target_roles.required_content: observed communication or website copy from a bounded legitimate entity
target_roles.required_evidence: official identity plus contradiction and impersonation review distinct from the text artifact

search_strata: English investment-scam posts or messages with primary provenance
English legitimate investment communications with official provenance
Vietnamese investment-scam posts or messages with primary provenance
Vietnamese legitimate investment communications with official provenance
multilingual investment-fraud research datasets with record-level source identifiers

required: publisher or repository identity is explicit
license, terms or academic-use basis is available before download
distribution includes UTF-8 TXT, CSV, JSON or JSONL without active content
records contain observed content rather than only entity or warning metadata
record-level provenance and stable identifiers are present
labels can be audited independently of the text and are not malware-derived
group or campaign identifiers can be created before splitting
reject: synthetic-only corpus proposed as real-world ground truth
warning-list or registry prose without a distinct observed artifact
dataset overlaps Mendeley V2 but lacks stable deduplication identifiers
validation or test content would need to be opened during discovery

promotion_gate: independent second review of every shortlisted source
endpoint security scan and file-type verification before parsing
zero credit to fresh V1-Core until review, reconciliation and owner acceptance
